classifications.rationale: The President establishes an internal advisory task force, an executive organizational action without changing substantive legal rights or duties.
classifications.evidence: I am establishing a Presidential Task Force on Global Resources and Environment.

classifications.rationale: The President assigns membership, assessment, consultation, and reporting responsibilities to an internal task force; these are executive organization and management functions.
classifications.evidence: The Task Force will report to me within six months and periodically thereafter on its progress

classifications.rationale: The President directs the task force to coordinate, prioritize attention, and assess federal efforts and analytical capabilities, without dictating a later legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: I have directed the Task Force to work closely with you in carrying out its responsibilities

classifications.rationale: The agencies must support the task force, while the task force must recommend priorities and report on possible program improvements; these are internal cooperation and reporting duties.
classifications.evidence: Each of your agencies shall cooperate with and support this important Task Force.
